item.title: Charleston County Parks to host Inclusive Silent Disco Jan. 31
item.description: Get ready to dance! Charleston County Parks is bringing back its Inclusive Silent Disco. This music event for people with disabilities and their families and friends will be held on Saturday, Jan. 31 from 5 – 6:30 p.m.

item.title: Virtual Transportation Sales Tax listening session announced ahead of Jan. 13 presentation to County Council
item.description: Charleston County officials are inviting residents to join a virtual listening session on Thursday, January 8, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. to provide feedback on a potential future extension of the Transportation Sales Tax (TST).

item.title: State Rep. Henderson-Myers Calls for Special Ad Hoc Committee to Address 'Measles Public Health Crisis'
item.description: tate Representative Rosalyn Henderson-Myers (D-Spartanburg) is calling for the South Carolina House of Representatives to convene a special ad hoc committee to address the ongoing public health crisis sparked by 147 confirmed cases of measles

item.title: Dorchester County Extends Office Hours Prior to the End of Year
item.description: To better serve the community during the busy holiday season, Dorchester County Government offices will open early on Monday, Dec. 29; Tuesday, Dec. 30; and Wednesday. Dec. 31.

item.title: A Beginner’s Guide to MDF Applications
item.description: Medium-density fibreboard, more commonly known as MDF, is one of the most widely used engineered wood products in modern interiors and furniture making. Affordable, versatile, and easy to work with, it has become a go-to material for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike. If you’re new to MDF, this guide will walk you through what it is, why it’s so popular, and how it’s commonly used around the home.
